assets.name: hoodie
assets.prompt: Edit the provided transparent game sprite atlas to make a SMOOTH EIGHT-FRAME TURN animation of the EXACT SAME Xiaoyu character in the lavender-white hoodie, lavender hair and pleated skirt. Production sprite sheet: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight isolated full-body figures, matching the original 1774×887 2:1 canvas proportions and cell positions. Reading order 1 through 8: front, slight three-quarter front, three-quarter side, side, three-quarter back, mostly back, nearly fully back, fully back. The head, body, eyes, hair and arms must smoothly rotate together as one coherent whole character; eyes remain correctly drawn without double images. Keep the exact same face, hairstyle, clip, clothing details, rendering style, height, scale and feet position as the reference. Feet stand anchored on the SAME bottom line in all eight cells. Each figure has complete anatomy, no extra limbs, no cuts, no detached pieces, no shadows, no ground, no text, no borders. Truly transparent background.
